phrase: newton called his calculus " the science of fluxions ", a term that endured in english schools into the 19th century. 54 : 100 the first complete treatise on calculus to be written in english and use the leibniz notation was not published until 1815. maria gaetana agnesi since the time of newton and leibniz, many mathematicians have contributed to the continuing development of calculus. one of the first and most complete works on both infinitesimal and integral calculus was written in 1748 by maria gaetana agnesi .
